en: I mixed the sugar with the coffee.
I did not mix the spices with the oil.
You mixed the eggs with the flour.
You did not mix the water with the milk.
You (f.) mixed the salad with oil.
You (f.) did not mix the vinegar with the water.
He mixed the paint in the bucket.
He did not mix the soup well yesterday.
She mixed the cheese with the eggs.
She did not mix the sugar with the tea.
We mixed everything in the big plate.
We did not mix up the work papers.
You (pl.) mixed the dough with water.
You (pl.) did not mix the colors in the drawing.
They mixed the vegetables with the rice.
They did not mix the honey with the milk.
I mix the medicine with water.

lat: ma kankhelletsh l-makla dyali b l-7ar
en: I do not mix my food with the spicy stuff.
You always mix work with home.
Why do you not mix the juice well?
You (f.) are mixing the cream with chocolate.

lat: nti ma katkhelltish s-sukkar f l-qehwa
en: You (f.) do not mix sugar in the coffee.
He mixes the dough with a spoon.
He does not mix work with play.
She mixes the fruit with yogurt.

lat: hiya ma katkhelletsh l-mel7a m3a l-kesksu
ar: هي ما كتخلطش الملحة مع الكسكسو
en: She does not mix salt into the couscous.
We mix the flour with yeast.
We do not mix fava beans with chickpeas.
You (pl.) mix olives with lemon.

lat: ntuma ma katkhelltush l-alwan f d-ders
en: You (pl.) do not mix the colors in the lesson.
They mix cement with sand.
They do not mix cheese into the sandwich.

lat: ghadi nkhellet l-3ejina dyal l-kika f l-kuzina
ar: غادي نخلط العجينة ديال الكيكة فالكوزينة
en: I am going to mix the cake dough in the kitchen.

lat: ma ghadish nkhellet l-7lib m3a l-limun
ar: ما غاديش نخلط الحليب مع الليمون
en: I am not going to mix milk with lemon.

lat: nta ghadi tkhellet l-3etriya m3a l-l7em
ar: نتا غادي تخلط العطرية مع اللحم
en: You are going to mix the spices with the meat.

lat: ma ghadish tkhellet l-wraq dyal l-imtihan
ar: ما غاديش تخلط الوراق ديال الامتحان
en: You are not going to mix up the exam papers.

lat: ghedda ghadi tkhellti l-krim f d-dar
en: Tomorrow you (f.) are going to mix the cream at home.

lat: nti ma ghadish tkhellti z-zit m3a l-ma
ar: نتي ما غاديش تخلطي الزيت مع الماء
en: You (f.) are not going to mix oil with water.
He is going to mix the paint today.

lat: ma ghadish ykhellet l-makla f t-tebsil
en: He is not going to mix the food on the plate.

lat: hiya ghadi tkhellet s-sukkar f l-berrad
en: She is going to mix the sugar in the teapot.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tkhellet d-dwa m3a l-3asir
ar: هي ما غاديش تخلط الدوا مع العصير
en: She is not going to mix the medicine with juice.

lat: ghadi nkhelltu l-khodra m3a l-l7em f t-tajin
ar: غادي نخلطو الخضرة مع اللحم فالطاجين
en: We are going to mix the vegetables with meat in the tagine.

lat: ma ghadish nkhelltu l-ma l-bard m3a s-skhun
ar: ما غاديش نخلطو الماء البارد مع السخون
en: We are not going to mix cold water with hot water.

lat: ntuma ghadi tkhelltu s-salada dyal l-fakya
ar: نتوما غادي تخلطو السلطة ديال الفاكية
en: You (pl.) are going to mix the fruit salad.

lat: ma ghadish tkhelltu d-drari m3a l-kbar
ar: ما غاديش تخلطو الدراري مع الكبار
en: You (pl.) are not going to mix the kids with the adults.

lat: huma ghadi ykhelltu l-3ejina b l-khellat
en: They are going to mix the dough with the mixer.
They are not going to mix the colors today.
